objective: Independent, read-only, hash-pinned measurement of (A) whether the three extension-predicate convention axes raised by HF-091-02 (worker-091, 01:03) are asymmetric between live F2a and live F2b, and (B) whether the two live-hash F2a accepts (worker-017, worker-072) and the frozen structural gate actually cover those axes.
authority_note: worker measurement only; no canonical write, no node status, no validation_status=passed, no gate verdict.

hypotheses.H1: At the live pins, F2a lacks (a) an explicit smooth category for M', (b) an iota_regularity freeze, (c) the interior requirement in clause (f), while F2b contains all three. Measured by string/field extraction from the raw bytes.
hypotheses.H2: The two live-hash F2a accepts' executed check scripts do not assert any of the three axes; their extension-predicate check is a presence-of-clauses/regularity/direction check. H2 is REFUTED if either script contains an axis-specific assertion.
hypotheses.H3: The frozen structural gate (check_class_schema.py 000e09e4) is indifferent to the three axes: mutants m1 (topological M'), m2 (iota_regularity added as C0), m3 (interior requirement added to clause (f)) all still PASS, while positive controls m4 (conclusion_type -> C0 token) and m5 (empty must_not_conflate) FAIL. H3 is REFUTED if any axis mutant FAILS.
hypotheses.H4: The two accepts are hash-valid at the live F2a pin (reviewed/artifact sha256 == measured e9a27996...) and declare counts_as_full_schema_verdict=true; hence the issue is a criterion-coverage gap, not a procedural hash defect.

controls.K1: F2b positive control: all three axes are found in F2b (extractor sanity).
controls.K2: Covered-axis control: 072's C10 asserts frozen_regularity==C2, an axis value that IS covered; the coverage classifier must return covered for it (not blanket-negative).
controls.K3: Determinism: two independent passes produce identical result digests.
controls.K4: Pin stability: all declared pins re-measure identically at exit.
controls.K5: Null control: the frozen gate PASSes the three unmutated canonical schemas.

falsifiers.F1: Any of the three axes is measured symmetric at the live bytes (then H1/A refuted).
falsifiers.F2: Either accept's executed check script contains an assertion on the axis (then H2 refuted for that axis/accept).
falsifiers.F3: Any axis mutant causes the frozen gate to FAIL (then H3 refuted; the gate does cover that axis).
falsifiers.F4: Any declared pin moves during the run (binding void, fail-closed).
falsifiers.F5: A live-hash accept's reviewed sha256 differs from the measured F2a sha (then H4 refuted for that accept).

expected_information_gain: Decides whether the two existing F2a accepts can discharge HF-091-02 for the 02:45 G-FORM adjudication, or whether a convention ruling / rev14 freeze plus fresh verdicts is required.
